articles.title: Wall Street backbone DTCC brings $30 trillion securities closer to blockchain with major banks
articles.snippet: DTCC's tokenization service went live on Canton Network and private chain Besu, with JPMorgan, Citi and Morgan Stanley among 20 firms signed up.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin trading just above $81,000 as Fed delivers hold on rates
articles.snippet: Strategy's preferred stocks, STRC among them, are moving to daily dividends after a successful shareholder vote.

articles.title: Nearly 90% of large businesses are embracing tokenized cash to speed up payments: DBS
articles.snippet: Stablecoins lead instruments in use or planned at 63%, ahead of tokenized deposits at 53% and tokenized money market funds at 52%.

articles.title: Mirae Asset Securities issues tokenized notes on Solana
articles.snippet: The company’s Hong Kong unit issued six-month notes under its $3 billion program, extending blockchain-based distribution to institutional investors.

articles.title: Bitcoin price analysis sees ‘strong rally’ as old coins become dormant
articles.snippet: A decline in the share of Bitcoin’s realized cap held by coins unmoved for 18 months or longer points to the ‘early stages’ of a bull market, analysis says.
